name: zzy-blog
description: zzy's static blog, built with Astro Pure.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/verify-static.mjs
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 deploy --env preview --config ./wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 deploy --env '' --config ./wrangler.jsonc
